target: NEXY Partial-Order Verification Lab reference implementation

requirements.requirement: All mutations stay inside the isolated AI-CONTEXT work root and no repository whose name contains NEXY.AI is mutated.
notes: Local artifact construction cannot prove GitHub persistence scope; final read-back/commit audit will update this status.

requirements.requirement: Equivalent normalized input yields deterministic model/result identity and output ordering.
notes: 20 deterministic CLI replays produced one unique output digest in local validation.

requirements.requirement: Independence is conservative: opaque/incomplete effects, causal order, write/write and read/write conflicts prevent commuting.
Reduction blocks when dependency completeness or property trace-invariance is not attested.
Bounded exact audit must prove representative class coverage against all legal traces and fail on mismatch.
notes: Generated small-model exact suite covers 1,184 model instances.

requirements.requirement: Plan-only POR class coverage is cross-checked by an independent brute-force test oracle not using engine exhaustive enumeration.
notes: Independent test-side oracle covers 256 four-action models.

requirements.requirement: Search/output limits block instead of silently truncating required representatives.
Metric-only full-trace counting may be omitted under its budget without silently weakening the reduced-plan safety conditions.
Malformed JSON shapes, missing dependencies, duplicate IDs and cycles fail closed.
notes: A regression test was added after discovering scalar-string array coercion during implementation.

requirements.requirement: The project must remain explicitly AI-proposed and must not claim NEXY integration/runtime/deployment evidence.
